text: In Holstenwall, a shadowy town of twisted buildings and spiralling streets, the mysterious Dr. Caligari opens a [coffin-like box|images|graves, coffins and funerals] at the fair to wake Cesare, a somnambulist who answers the crowd's questions. When young Alan asks how long he will live, Cesare tells him [until dawn tomorrow|rules|death sends warnings], and that night Alan is [stabbed to death in his bed|wrong|a life taken]. Grieving, his friend Franzis follows Caligari into an insane asylum and finds [the director's records and diary|ending|the hidden truth comes out].
